about_the_game:
DigiME: Your Ultimate Virtual Studio & Motion Capture Suite

Bring your digital identity to life with DigiME—a high-performance motion capture tool designed for streamers, content creators, and VTubers. By leveraging advanced Computer Vision and Digital Signal Processing, DigiME translates your real-world movements and voice into a virtual performance in real-time. No specialized suits or expensive sensors required—just your webcam and microphone.

Unmatched Freedom & Customization Your Live Avatar

  • Universal Avatar Support: Go beyond presets. You have total freedom to import your own VRM (VRoid) files, allowing you to use your unique, custom-made characters.

  • HDR Environment Hosting: Create the perfect atmosphere by uploading your own HDR format backgrounds, providing a great 3D stage that fits your brand.

  • Live Voice Transformer: Complete your transformation with the integrated Voice Changer. Modify your tone and pitch in real-time to perfectly match your avatar’s personality.

  • Advanced Motion Tracking: Experience fluid upper-body, facial, and hand-gesture recognition. Our latest update ensures high-precision tracking for more natural, lifelike interactions.

Optimized Streaming Performance

  • Optimized for Gaming: Built to run seamlessly alongside demanding titles. Utilizing NVIDIA RTX GPU acceleration and Intel OpenVINO optimization, DigiME delivers high-FPS animation with minimal system impact.

  • Global Accessibility: The software features full Multi-language support, ensuring a seamless experience for creators worldwide.

  • Friendly Setup for Streaming: Broadcast instantly to Twitch, YouTube, Discord, and Zoom via effortless virtual camera integration.

Meet MIA: Your Personalized Assistant

MIA is your on-screen co-pilot, ready to assist with software navigation and hardware optimization. You can now customize MIA’s appearance and voice to your preference, making her a truly personalized part of your streaming setup. She provides expert recommendations on MSI hardware and up-to-date tech industry insights.

Unlock the Full Experience with MSI Member Login

Sign in with your MSI Member account to unlock the DigiME full potential.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 10th Gen / i5 11th Gen or above; AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Ryzen 7 5800 or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or above; AMD Radeon RX 6600 or above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A standard webcam with 720P resolution and microphone is required. Note: An NPU paired with a GPU can enhance performance by offloading AI-related tasks such as camera-based motion tracking, freeing up the GPU for processing-intensive work like textures and advanced graphics rendering.
